question: Should Commerce adopt the proposed public storefront-availability resolver and authenticated policy routes as its next supported contract?
rationale: The implementation adds durable settings and exported plugin APIs; source compatibility alone cannot establish whether this is the desired permanent product surface.

options.title: Adopt the scoped contract
options.body: Accept the resolver, policies, and authenticated routes as the supported Commerce availability API while retaining the documented deferred UI and transport work.

options.title: Narrow before adoption
options.body: Keep the implementation private or reduce the public API until the desired storefront integration boundary is decided.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped contract
recommendation.body: Accept the resolver, policies, and authenticated routes as the supported Commerce availability API while retaining the documented deferred UI and transport work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature lineage ties this contributor to the adjacent managed-inventory work and the proposed availability contract.
